title: C2 authorize: decision
description: Authorizer answer: allow or deny and a reason code from the registry. The full reason is written to the audit; for a stop and for a permission denial the model gets the same short "no permission" (HLD-1, PRM-8). The needs field names the permissions the initiator lacked, as a code only (PRM-8).

reason.description: Denial reason, required for deny: for example held, no_group_cap, tenant_mismatch, self_approve, privileged_group, operator_only.

needs.description: Which capability was missing; a closed field of the denial (PRM-8).

items.description: Group capability: a string of the form <form>:<name> from capabilities.yaml, without an asterisk, for example task:ops.investigate.v1, service.control:nginx, admin:people.

hold.description: The stop that fired, if the reason is held.

stage.description: At which step the decision was made: stops, unconditional prohibitions or permission intersection (PRM-2).
